name: Graveguard
description:
"Wights are driven by a malign intelligence all their own, not the unquestioning allegiance of their lesser counterpart. Just as a powerful necromancer will some day die and rise again as an Undead, all his vile powers intact, so too can the greatest of the warrior heroes. Many of them are truly ancient, the remnants of an aboriginal, tribal people who once occupied the lands of the Empire thousands of years before it was so known."

—Waldemarr, scholar of Nuln.

Taken from: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 2nd Edition: Old World Bestiary

name: Strigoi Vampire
description:
The Strigoi are one of the five Vampire bloodlines of the Old World, and are all descended from the Trueborn Vampire Lord Ushoran, a former prince of the Nehekharan city-state of Lahmia.

The Vampires of the other bloodlines play at being mortal and wear the robes of lords, knights, and princes, but underneath, the Vampire is purely a savage, bloodthirsty beast. There are those Vampires who lose themselves so much in their pretense of mortality that they forget this.

The Strigoi have not forgotten and do not pretend. They embrace the beast within them, taking all the strength and fury that savage force can give them. That strength is terrible to behold, and that fury knows no end.

— Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 2nd Edition: Night’s Dark Masters, pp. 66–72.

name: Knight of Khorne · Axe
description:
I have never seen men fight like that...

I barely made it out alive, this was no victory.

Statues of brass, massive, twice the size of the biggest man I've ever seen and then some.

Walking, not charging... advancing like a great wall made of brass and blood red steel.

I saw men throw down their weapons crying, screaming...

Men crawled beneath one another to get away...

It made no difference, there was nowhere to run.

I watched a man split from shoulder to hip as he was trying to hide.

Another crushed into nothing I could recognize...

Men were knocked down, trampled, hacked apart and still they kept hacking at the corpses.

Like a butcher at the block, hacking away piece by piece.

It made no difference, we had to fight.

They even killed each other.

The ones we managed to injure or stagger fighting back became obstacles for the others,

So they simply cut through those to reach us faster.

But I think they knew they would die that day.

I heard they razed ten cities before they reached us.

That they had come down from the north on a path of destruction.

That they had fought their way south for weeks leaving behind only blood and ash.

By the time they reached us they were outnumbered fifty to one.

We had heard of them coming.

We had heard what they had done.

Rivers of blood.

But It made no difference... I wanted to fight... to kill.

They did not run or beg.

They knew they were going to die, I think they wanted to.

My city has lost everything defeating them and they got what they came for.

You call this victory...?

Somehow... I envy them.

I have spent all my life afraid... Afraid of pain... regret... death...

Afraid of fear.

Those men were afraid of nothing.

Wanted nothing.

Kept nothing...

But it made no difference... I killed them too.

North...

That is where they came from.

That is where I will go.

name: Knight of Nurgle
description:
There are many strange places to end up in the Old World...

Some would claim the strangest is tucked within the comforting embrace of the Urfather.

But why? What could drive mortal men to seek out something so wrong?

Tell me, what would a knight who has lost his family to war continue fighting for? What is left to endure for those whose martial strength proved meaningless against the plights of life?

The strongest men are not broken with swords... I can tell you that much.

It is there, in those dark corners of the mind you will hear him whisper to you.

His embrace, his promises...

No more restless nights. No more seeing faces long buried. No more graves to dig... no more watching those you once loved fade and turn to dust... no more fearing the years that seem to pass faster and faster.

He would take all the pain away.

He would tuck those memories gently to sleep, still the passing of time, and silence every wound that steel could never mend...

Such a watchful father.

A good father.

He does keep his promises.

The pain fades...

Then the feelings.

Then the memories.

Then flesh swells, old wounds open and blossom yet ache no more, flies gather beneath a rusted visor and the body slowly rots... but somehow refuses to die.

But from that warm, rotten embrace do those knights rise once again...

Perhaps to you they are disgusting abominations, bringers of death and decay, swollen, corpse-like and clad in rusted steel.

But in truth?

They have purpose.

They are at peace.

They are happy.

Are you?...

name: Knight of Slaanesh · Axe
description:
How good of you to come all this way, just to watch me cut you apart.

I see you struggle... I know this is difficult, to die... really, I do.

But if you would just hold still, this would be over so much sooner.

You might think I hate you but I don't.

I take great pleasure in what we are doing together, you and I.

This little act of killing you is merely one scene in a much grander performance.

You, your friends, your people, these lands... you are all background players in my great presence, can't you feel it?

You should feel honored, my sword is inside you, after all.

You see, I WANT to be here.

I want to take this from you.

I want to look into your eyes while you grasp what you are losing.

That moment...

That is the pleasure.

Short but so so good...

I said hold still!

You know, I was like you once.

I lived in these lands, I was a Knight of Bretonnia... I loved my Lady.

Love...

What a tedious thing.

It gives you nothing.

Look what it gave you, holding your guts like that.

You weren't a knight for very long, were you?

...

You really are having difficulty holding still.

And why are you screaming?

Hmm...

Perhaps I should cut out your tongue.

It would make it much easier for you to listen... you NEED to listen.

Now...

Hold still...

name: Aspiring Champion
description:
None have tasted power so sweet and so alluring as those who have bent the knee to the Ruinous Powers.

Mighty warlords, knights, holy men and even women... once they have glimpsed such power, they can no longer unsee.

They come to crave it, carving their path toward eternal glory or damnation, fighting harder and harder with every battle to prove their worth in the eyes of Chaos... they are the Aspiring Champions.

This is... FaceHelm... the mighty leaper of Norsca.

name: Bretonnian Archer
author: HerrDave
description:
"Whilst highborn knights are the true backbone of most Bretonnian armies, the peasants form the overall bulk. In times of war, these peasants often receive no training at all and are simply rounded up and pointed at the enemy. Men-at-arms, on the other hand, are probably the closest thing to a professional soldier a Bretonnian army can field. These soldiers are equipped and trained at the expense of their local lord to fight on his behalf, with recruitment often starting at a relatively young age."

This pack includes

- Bretonnian swordsman

- Bretonnian archer

- Bretonnian pikeman

Uses all in-game textures

"Suffer not the heretics to live, loyal of Sigmar!"

I started this model a rather long time ago, figured I'd finish it as a bit of a herald to a flood of models once "The thing" is done.
credits:
Model - HerrDave

Original resource - Warhammer Witch Hunter

name: Knight of Tzeentch · Sword
description:
This has been my company for a thousand wars, a thousand roads, a thousand years.

My brothers, that is what we call each other.

We have ridden beneath this banner for centuries... and yet I cannot recall their names nor their faces.

Did they ever have faces?...

We hail from every corner of the world, or so we remember.

Worlds I see when we close our eyes, cities beneath violet skies and fields without horizons...

And always above it all a great burning eye, watching, above as the sun.

We had different lives once, different faces, different banners... I recall, sometimes.

Perhaps that was a thousand years ago, perhaps it was yesterday...

Or, perhaps, was it another man's dream?

We cannot tell, it does not matter.

As we ride, days stretch into years and years collapse into moments, time has no meaning.

Roads unfold never ending, the ground beneath us breathes and lives and trees bend and whisper to us secrets men do not wish to hear.

The ravens herald our coming.

We can recall a thousand battles,

kingdoms we have brought to ashes, kings slain, gods destroyed.

But I do not remember arriving at any of them, only leaving.

How did we end up here?

A voice...

A will...

but whose?...

In war we see it clearly, we feel alive... and for a moment, I wake up...

The trees stand still, the ravens fall silent and the skies are no longer violet when the ground runs red with blood...

For a moment...

For another thousand years....

But always... When we shut our eyes... A burning eye, staring, reaching deep into my soul.
credits:
Model Base - Vile Knight by HerrDave / Further edited by Stein123 
Chaos Stars, Bitz and bobs - Chaos Warriors by Diazon, found on Warhammer Eternal Strife by Nightmare2077 
Animated Eyes - Hatchet Eye Drranosh by ratamahatta (Added many frames to make it smoother)

Blade - Devouring Blade by Blood Raven 
Tzeentchian Symbol - projected from 2D image using MDLxL 
Tzeentchian Style Weapon Guard - Tzeentch Hero Pack by Grey Knight 
Blue Horror on Shield -Tzeentch Horror converted from DoW by biridius , Edited heavily by Stein123 and me.

Horse head and tail - Headless Horseman by Johnwar 
Fur Cloak, Helm base - Chaos Warrior by Azazeron 
Helmet Horn - adapted from IronMaiden's Dawn of War Helms .

Gem on Sword - Radiant Emerald Cleaver by Sunchips
